disposition.note: Both 50%-alpha shape interiors read ~20 levels darker than GT because our theme outerShdw is cast at its full 35% under a translucent fill, while PowerPoint attenuates the shadow by the fill's alpha (GT shadow SMask max 89 on slide 1, 45 on slide 2). Halving the theme shadow alpha in a counterfactual copy brings these pixels within 5 levels of GT. Same shadow-follows-painted-alpha rule as #2158 (its alpha-0 case).
